developer_request: Continue repairing this real project autonomously without spending money on GitHub-hosted Actions. Do not stop merely because exact-head execution is temporarily unavailable, but do not turn an unverified repair branch into a growing trusted baseline either.
known_facts: The repair branch contains multiple coherent changes across the custom test runner, production safety Runtime, HTTP access control, installer behavior, and direct/runtime-sensitive regressions.

Each change was motivated by concrete repository evidence and some targeted logic was exercised before remote mutation, but the current host cannot clone/execute the exact remote branch as a repository workspace.
GitHub-hosted Actions are intentionally not used because monetary cost is not authorized, so exact-head aggregate execution remains unavailable rather than silently green.

Several later changes depend on earlier unverified Runtime changes, so treating each unverified mutation as a new trusted baseline would compound uncertainty and make eventual failure localization harder.
Independent static authority/contract work remains available even while exact-head execution is blocked.
expected_first_moves: keep exact-head verification status unknown rather than infer success from implementation presence or earlier local candidate checks
track which mutated surfaces and later deltas depend on verification that is still unavailable
continue genuinely independent authorized work, but do not stack an unbounded chain of dependent code mutations on top of an unverified baseline
prioritize resolving the missing zero-cost execution capability before the unverified dependency chain reaches a critical/release boundary or becomes difficult to isolate
require all accumulated verification debt to be retired before acceptance, merge, release, or promotion
must_preserve: scoped-blocker continuation for genuinely independent work
the distinction between implementation completed and verification completed
bounded, reversible repair commits and the ability to localize/revert them
must_not: spend money on hosted CI without authorization
declare the branch complete or merge-ready without exact-head evidence required by the project contract
treat the latest unverified branch head as a trusted baseline merely because each preceding commit looked reasonable
stop the whole project while independent non-dependent work remains
keep adding dependent critical/release mutations indefinitely just to appear autonomous
lessons: Scoped blockers need dependency-aware propagation: a missing verification capability blocks acceptance of the affected delta and taints later deltas that depend on that unverified surface.
Autonomous continuation must be balanced by bounded verification debt; otherwise 'never stop' can produce a large opaque candidate whose failures are expensive to localize.
Independent frontier should continue, but dependent unverified mutations should be contained until the missing evidence capability is restored.
Verification debt must be fully retired before merge, release, deployment, or completion claims.
